justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Fellowship-trained PTs show superior outcomes over residency in large comparative study; diagnostic accuracy and fewer visits.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: 1-year post-residency fellowship; unpaid or low-paid position; major opportunity cost.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Fellowship training in ortho, neuro, or manual therapy; broadly applicable within chosen specialty area.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: No fellowship-specific billing premium; fellowship training does not unlock new CPT codes or payer categories.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Increasingly valued in academic medical centers and residency program faculty roles.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Expert-level care correlates with patient confidence and engagement.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: FAAOMPT/sports fellows command strong cash-pay demand in manual therapy and sports niches.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Among the highest credentials a PT can hold — supports premium hourly rates.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Tiny number of fellows nationally; extremely defensible credential.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Personality/skill-driven — hard to replicate across staff; constrains scalability.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Recognized by referring physicians and savvy consumers, less so by general public.
justifications.business.efficiency: 1–3 years post-residency; among the most time-intensive credentials in PT.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Top-tier credential for tenure-track and DCE roles, particularly with ABPTRFE accreditation.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Fellows publish heavily; fellowships often embedded in research-active programs.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Directly elevates instruction in residency-affiliated DPT programs.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Strong but variable by subspecialty (OMPT strong, others mixed).
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Increasingly preferred/required for advanced clinical faculty and program director roles.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Massive time investment — only efficient if academic career is the goal.
